brief.audience: The Brew92 crowd in Al Olaya is a young‑to‑mid‑age, style‑savvy Saudi mix that loves upbeat Arabic pop (Ahlam, Shamma Hamdan, Myriam Fares) and energetic global beats (Malu Trevejo). They also gravitate toward trendy local brands like Dose Cafe, Nice Stores and fashion‑forward names such as Eman Alajlan, seeking Instagram‑worthy experiences and a blend of modern and traditional flavors.

menu.idea: Cardamom‑infused Arabic coffee float topped with dates‑flavored ice‑cream and a sprinkle of crushed pistachios
menu.why: Combines the beloved Arabic coffee culture (favoured by the audience) with a sweet, Instagram‑ready twist that echoes the festive vibe of artists like Ahlam and Myriam Fares.

menu.idea: Rose‑scented pistachio latte served with a crumble of baklava
menu.why: Marries classic Saudi dessert notes (rose, pistachio, baklava) with specialty coffee, appealing to the audience’s love for traditional flavors presented in a modern, shareable format.

menu.idea: Za’atar avocado toast with labneh drizzle and a side of spiced chickpea crunch
menu.why: Offers a savory, health‑forward option that aligns with the trendy, youthful palate of the Nice Stores and Dose Cafe followers while staying rooted in regional taste.
